counterfactual_missing_items: Radiographic studies did not reveal any jaw cysts
No palmar or plantar pits were observed
decisive_items: A conserved splice-site mutation in SUFU gene (c.757-2A>G) in all tumor and normal tissue samples
buds and cords of basaloid cells enclosing small cystic spaces
response.rationale: R3 integrates the germline SUFU splice-site mutation, multiple skin-colored papules on face/vulva, and basaloid histology, matching nevoid basal cell carcinoma syndrome. R5 only cites the histologic pattern (infundibulocystic BCC) without the syndromic genetic and clinical context, making it a component rather than the unifying diagnosis.
